name: @opt2/communications
description: SYNTHETIC communications service: template store, SMTP send, delivery status, login-mail and survey-schedule consumers

scripts.generate: node -e "for (const d of ['src/generated/clients','src/generated/events']) require('node:fs').mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true})" && openapi-typescript contracts/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/openapi.ts && openapi-typescript ../surveys/contracts/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/clients/surveys.ts && json2ts -i ../identity/contracts/events/identity.login-mail.requested.v1.json -o src/generated/events/identity.login-mail.requested.v1.ts && json2ts -i ../surveys/contracts/events/surveys.survey.scheduled.v1.json -o src/generated/events/surveys.survey.scheduled.v1.ts && json2ts -i ../programs-sites/contracts/events/programs-sites.site.changed.v1.json -o src/generated/events/programs-sites.site.changed.v1.ts && json2ts -i contracts/events/communications.message.delivery-status-changed.v1.json -o src/generated/events/communications.message.delivery-status-changed.v1.ts
scripts.test:contract: npm run generate && vitest run test/contract
scripts.test:security: npm run generate && vitest run test/security
